_comment: FALLBACK thresholds. These are a guess, not a measurement, and tell-scan
says so loudly on every run that uses them. They exist so the tool does
something sensible before a corpus exists — not so you can skip building one.
Replace them by putting known-human writing in this profile's corpus/human/
catalog_density is a PER-ENTRY ceiling in hits per 1000 words, by severity.
A single catalog entry above its ceiling is flagged; below it, the hit is
still reported but not treated as elevated.
metrics bands use low/high limits. Derived thresholds replace them with
p10/p50/p90 percentile bands measured from the corpus.
